tools.name: latest_stories
tools.description: The latest art-world stories from The Cultural Signal's wire: auction results, exhibitions, acquisitions, appointments, fairs. Each story has the facts paragraph, an editorial signal, source institution, original press-release URL, event date and cities. Newest first, at most 2 per source.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Whole-word search over the most recent 200 stories (headline, body and tags). Use for an artist, gallery, museum, auction house, fair or city, e.g. 'Basquiat', 'Phillips', 'Art Basel'.

tools.name: art_jobs
tools.description: Open jobs at museums, galleries and auction houses. Optional filters: role (e.g. curatorial, registrar, sales, marketing) and city slug (e.g. new-york, london, paris, hong-kong).

tools.name: fair_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming art fair editions with dates, city, venue and a permanent page URL. Optional region filter.

tools.name: salary_data
tools.description: Aggregated art-world salary ranges by role and currency from published job postings (CC BY 4.0; buckets with 5+ postings only).
